messages:
elaine: Quick ask 100 tighten homepage hero copy for the launch. Objective: one concise hero that is mode-agnostic but funnels Hosted vs Dedicated/Private correctly. Thoughts?

mohit: Key must-haves: clear lead gen routing, two CTAs (self-serve hosted vs enterprise contact), and a webinar teaser.

julia: How about we keep the headline short and put the modes in the strapline. Draft: 
  Headline: "Ship LLM features with predictable performance"
  Strapline: "Use our Hosted API to get started, or scale to Dedicated and Private deployments with the same API."

sam: Nice. Can we surface a one-line credibility point under the strapline? e.g. "Benchmarked across open models for latency and cost". Only include if we link to benchmarks.

elaine: Agree on linking. We'll add an inline link: "See benchmarks -> /benchmarks". Try to avoid hard numbers in the hero.

tessa: UI suggestion: add a 3-pill selector under the hero: Hosted | Dedicated | Private. Each pill is a micro-CTA with one-line benefit and drives different funnels.

mohit: Routing map proposal: 
  - Hosted pill -> /signup?utm=hero_mode&mode=hosted -> Growth SDR/auto-onboard flow
  - Dedicated/Private pills -> /contact-enterprise?utm=hero_mode&mode=enterprise -> Enterprise form + AE trigger

copybot: Pill microcopy drafts: 
  Hosted 0: "Get started instantly with hosted API + free credits"
  Dedicated: "Reserved GPU pools and predictable throughput"
  Private: "VPC and on-prem options with KMS and audit logs"

julia: Love the pills. Also add a secondary row of 3 bullets (mini benchmark narrative) beneath pills: 
  - "Caching and smart batching lowered token costs and raised throughput for chat workloads."
  - "Routing policies enable graceful degradation during regional capacity constraints."
  - "Observability shows per-route latency & cost so teams can tune tradeoffs."

sam: Reword first bullet to avoid exact claim: "Caching and batching reduced per-token spend in customer workloads while maintaining latency SLOs."

elaine: Good call. Webinar piece: 45-minute technical session with Q&A. Working title: "Serving LLMs in Production: latency, cost, and resilient routing". Panel: infra lead, research eng, solutions SE.

mohit: Social post copy (short): 
  "How do teams keep LLM features fast and affordable? Join our engineers for a technical playbook on latency, batching, and routing. Wed May 6 1 register: <shortlink>"

tessa: For the enterprise form, include fields: company name, company size, expected qps, cloud provider, compliance needs, checkbox "Request capacity planning call". Checkbox triggers AE/SE routing.

julia: Layout suggestion: Hero -> pills -> mini-bench bullets -> CTAs (Try hosted / Contact enterprise) -> webinar CTA link. Mobile-first frames in Figma please.

mohit: UTMs to standardize: 
  Try hosted: /signup?utm_campaign=hero_mode&utm_mode=hosted
  Contact enterprise: /contact?utm_campaign=hero_mode&utm_mode=enterprise
  Webinar: /events/serve-llms?utm_campaign=webinar_hero

elaine: One more constraint: keep headline <= 12 words and avoid enumerating modes there. Put them in the strapline or pills.

sam: I'll compile approved benchmark language snippets we can display.

tessa: I'll author the enterprise form + routing doc and share by EOD.

julia: On it 1 prepping Figma frames and mobile variants for the sprint.

copybot: Reminder scheduled: "Hero copy sprint - mode-agnostic headline" tomorrow 10:00 PT. :bell:

elaine: Thanks team. See you at the sprint. :thumbsup:
